rows.jyutping: paau1 hei3 A ge3 hang4 wai4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to the act of abandoning A, especially a person, duty, or responsibility.

example.english: The company's sudden closure was really an act of desertion toward its workers.
example.traditional: 間公司突然執笠，根本就係拋棄員工嘅行為。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 dat6 jin4 zap1 lap1 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 paau1 hei3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 hang4 wai4
